title: VPN Connectivity Troubleshooting
keywords: vpn network remote access connectivity authentication gateway
content: Check VPN gateway availability, authentication service health, user account status, client configuration, and recent network changes. Confirm whether the issue affects one user or many users.

title: Password Reset and Account Access
keywords: password reset login account authentication credentials access
content: Verify identity, account lock status, password policy, reset-token validity, and identity-provider availability. Ask the user to retry after the account state is confirmed.

title: Corporate Email Outage
keywords: email outlook mailbox mail service unavailable messaging
content: Check messaging service health, authentication, mailbox availability, DNS/connectivity, and whether the issue is isolated or organization-wide. Review service alerts and recent changes.

title: Database Connection Failure
keywords: database sql db connection timeout application
content: Check database availability, connection pool health, credentials, network connectivity, resource utilization, and recent deployments. Review application and database logs.

title: Application or API Service Down
keywords: server application api service down outage deployment
content: Check service health, recent deployments, API dependencies, server resources, logs, and monitoring alerts. Determine whether rollback or escalation is required.

title: Network Connectivity Issue
keywords: network internet wifi connectivity packet loss dns
content: Check scope of affected users, network device health, DNS resolution, routing, packet loss, and recent network changes. Compare with monitoring alerts.

title: Software Installation Request
content: Confirm software name, approved version, device compatibility, licensing and user permissions. Follow organizational software approval and deployment procedures.

title: Server Performance Issue
keywords: server cpu memory performance latency slow
content: Check CPU, memory, disk, process health, latency, traffic and recent changes. Identify whether the degradation is isolated or service-wide.

title: Access Permission Issue
content: Verify the requested resource, user role, group membership and authorization policy. Confirm approvals before modifying permissions.

title: Incident Escalation Guidelines
keywords: escalation priority critical high incident impact sla
content: Escalate incidents based on business impact, urgency, affected users and service criticality. Critical production outages or broad business impact require rapid escalation and human review.
